name: 34029-longprefill-qwen3moe30b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90, NVLink between the cards.
parallelism: TP=4 with expert parallelism enabled, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one node.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse MoE: 48 layers, 128 experts with 8 active per token, 32 query / 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, fp8 e4m3 block-quantized weights over bf16 activations. Read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, unbounded arrival rate. Bounded at 768 requests with a 900 s safety cap, of which 256 are warmup (`warmup: {value: 256, mode: requests}`), leaving about 512 scored. No cooldown. Seed static 34029. 128 streams is matched by the engine's `max-num-seqs: 128`, so the engine's own cap never binds.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 8192 tokens and output exactly 256 (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0.0), `request_format: plain` so the prompt reaches the engine as raw text with no chat template around it. The backend sets ignore_eos alongside max_tokens, so every request generates all 256 output tokens and every request is the same size of work.
purpose: A reasoning assistant digesting 8K-token documents into short answers for 128 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
max-num-seqs: 128

# Pinned rather than left to the engine's default: `vllm serve` and an in-process engine
# construction resolve different entries of the same defaults table at this commit. Keep it.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Both are this engine's own defaults at this commit, written out so a change of default
# cannot move them.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
